paragraphs.text: The Vizag Atum is a group of people from Innistrad that are convinced that only the dead can reveal true wisdom. They revere geists , almost worship them, but they are also able to command them. They think the dead are easier to contend with than the living. Predictable, and easy to control.
Jacob Hauken grew up among the Vizag Atum, but left the group after a friend of his was murdered but the group was not interested in finding the culprit.
They may be related to the Quietus Cult, who also seek wisdom from the dead.
